sections.body:
[db=live]Welcome to the Retribution Paladin rotation guide for Midnight Season 2! This guide will teach you all about the optimal rotation for Retribution Paladin across its various talent builds. It will cover both core ability cadence and cooldown usage in dungeons and raids for [b]Midnight Season 2[/b].
[pad]
[center][wrapper width=80%]
[nav]

sections.heading: How to Play Retribution
sections.body:
[h2 type=bar toc="How to Play Retribution"][color=c2]Retribution Paladin Rotation in Midnight Season 2[/color][/h2]

Retribution has a fairly straightforward rotation focusing on generating and spending Holy Power, along with some strong short cooldowns.

[wrapper width=1100px][box border=true]
[center][table style=grid]
[tr][td]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=spell_paladin_templarsverdict size=medium type=round color=c2 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=c2]Holy Power Economy:[/color][/b] Generating and spending Holy Power comprises the majority of your damage. Make sure to not waste it by generating it above the level you need.
	[/td][/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=inv_ability_holyfire_buff size=medium type=round color=c2 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=c2]Use Procs:[/color][/b] [spell=1261159] can be wasted if [spell=184575] isn't used fast enough. Make sure to be aware of when [spell=406064] procs in order to spend them as soon as possible. The buff stacks to 2, so you have some leeway to use them.
	[/td][/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=spell_holy_avenginewrath size=medium type=round color=c2 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=c2]Manage your cooldowns:[/color][/b] Although using them as soon as they come up is usually the best option, sometimes there can be situations where one ability is delayed and you need to hold it slightly in order for your cooldowns to all line up. There can also be situations where holding them for mechanics or extra add spawns can be better overall.[/td]
	[/tr]
[/table]
[/td][/tr][/table]
[/center]
[/box][/wrapper]
[pad]
[center][cta-button guide=33035 icon=spell_holy_auraoflight]Retribution Paladin Starter Guide[/cta-button][/center]

sections.heading: Rotation Priority
sections.body:
[h2 type=bar toc="Rotation Priority"][icon name=spell_holy_auraoflight type=round size=medium inline=true color=c2][/icon] Best Retribution Paladin Rotation[/h2]

Below, we break down the main priority lists for Retribution Paladin: Single-Target Rotation, AoE Rotation, and your opener sequence.
[wrapper width=95%][center][box border=true]
	[center][large][b][color=white]Hero Talent Master Switches[/color][/b][/large]
	[pad]
	You can use the master switches below to flip the [b][i]entire page's[/i][/b] options to your selected choice. The builds used on this page are covered in the [url guide=3064]Talents page[/url].[/center]

	[center]
	[wrapper width=95%]
		[grid align=centered]
			[display-option="templar" radio="Hero" icon=inv_glove_plate_raidpaladinmythic_q_01]Templar[/display-option]
			[display-option="herald-of-the-sun" radio="Hero" icon=inv_ability_heraldofthesunpaladin_dawnlight checked]Herald of the Sun[/display-option]
		[/grid]
	[/wrapper]
	[/center]
[/box][/center][/wrapper]
[br]
[tabs name="Rotations" uniform=true]

[wrapper width=850px]

sections.heading: Major Cooldowns
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Major Cooldowns" type=bar][color=c2][icon name=spell_holy_auraoflight type=round size=medium inline=true color=c2][/icon] Retribution Paladin Major Cooldowns[/color][/h2]
Retribution has quite a few cooldowns, mostly 30 and 60 second abilities, that will naturally line up together when used on cooldown.

[pad]

[tabs name="cds" uniform=true iconborders=true]

[tab name="Execution Sentence" icon=spell_paladin_executionsentence]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c2] Execution Sentence [/color][/h3]
The goal with [spell=343527] is to fit as much damage within its window as you can. All damage done to targets hit by the initial damage count towards the funnel portion, so you should keep using AoE abilities if you're fighting multiple targets. 
[/tab]
[tab name="Avenging Wrath" icon=ability_paladin_sanctifiedwrath]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c2] Avenging Wrath [/color][/h3]
[spell=31884] is a straightforward off-GCD damage buff that you'll want to make sure you have active before using other cooldowns. When using [spell=1253598], you'll ideally want to stack it sooner rather than later, but it's worth putting other abilities like [spell=343527] on cooldown before worrying about stacking it. 
[/tab]
[tab name="Radiant Glory" icon=achievement_dungeon_gloryoftheraider]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c2] Radiant Glory [/color][/h3]
[spell=458359] removes [spell=31884] as an active ability and instead automatically applies it when [spell=255937] is used. Because the duration of the buff is relatively short and [spell=255937] does a significant amount of damage, it's better to cast [spell=255937] inside a [spell=343527] window rather than trying to have a buff active before using [spell=343527] if you're using both of them.
[/tab]
[tab name="Hammer of Light" icon=inv_mace_1h_gryphonrider_d_02_silver]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c2] Hammer of Light [/color][/h3]
There's two situations when [spell=427453] will become castable: right after pressing [spell=255937], where it costs 3 Holy Power, and when you reach 50 stacks of [spell=425518], where it's free. You should always immediately cast [spell=427453] after [spell=255937], but procs can be held in some situations. If a free [spell=427453] proc happens just before [spell=31884] comes off cooldown it's a good idea to hold it, and it can also be held a few seconds if [spell=432626] is already active, but make sure to use it if [spell=31884] or [spell=343527] is about to end and before the proc expires.

[/tab]
[tab name="Trinkets" icon=inv_hammer_04]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c2] Trinkets [/color][/h3]
Retribution will often value on-use stat trinkets highly. Retribution can often use multiple of these, as they can be lined up with alternating cooldown sets with little downside. You should use them with [spell=31884], before your other important cooldowns. When using [item=193701], it can be channeled precombat on pull, but should otherwise be used before the rest of your cooldowns, since it takes a few seconds to gain its buff.

[spell=31884] doesn't buff the damage of trinket procs or on use effects, but it does increase their Crit chance, which means that for most instant on use trinkets you'll hold them a few seconds on pull for a little bit more damage. For trinkets with a cooldown desynced from [spell=31884], you generally don't want to hold it or [spell=31884] for 30s to line them up - this is a major damage loss as you'll often lose casts over a fight.
[/tab]

[/tabs]

sections.heading: Advanced Tips
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Advanced Tips" type=bar][color=c2][icon name=Inv_artifact_tome01 type=round size=medium inline=true color=c2][/icon] Retribution Paladin Advanced Tips[/color][/h2]

Rather than casting [spell=343527] directly after [spell=31884], it can be held until [spell=1253598] is stacked up. This is started during the opener and then repeated for each subsequent cooldown sequence. It is an extremely small damage increase when played optimally, less than 1%, but will be a damage loss when played suboptimally. Beyond [spell=1253598] stacks, this also means you are much more likely to cast all [spell=24275]s buffed by [spell=384027] inside [spell=343527].

[tooltip name=hol_proc]Most of the time you will simply cast procs instantly, but in some situations you may want to hold it for specific buffs.[/tooltip]
